resources.string: Press Follow to pick sports, competitions and teams; the launcher’s pill shows the match that matters.
Pick a competition to see its teams and today’s matches.
Badminton scores need a data key: Settings → Badminton data key.
No tournament in the feed for today or tomorrow.
This match is no longer in the list.
No further detail from the feed.
On: every 60 s while a screen shows a live match
India, IPL, ISL, Premier League, Champions League, F1
Remove every follow? The pill goes empty until you follow something again.
SportMicro’s Badminton Micro API on RapidAPI, with your own key (the row below)

BWF website (experimental): reads BWF’s own Match Centre in a hidden browser. No key. The page is read in a separate browser process that exits after each refresh, so its memory comes back; it may stop working when the site changes; live matches only.
Off: badminton is not fetched or shown
%1$s. The experimental source reads BWF’s own site through a hidden browser and may stop working when the site changes; the last scores are kept and marked stale. OK opens Settings.
BWF site unavailable: the experimental source could not read BWF’s Match Centre. Settings → Badminton source.
Not set: badminton is not fetched. Enter your own RapidAPI key for SportMicro’s Badminton Micro API (docs/providers.md). The free plan is 100 requests a day; beyond it the key may cost you money.
Set (ends in %1$s) · your own key, fetched at most every 5 min while a badminton follow is live, so the free plan’s 100 requests a day last; beyond it the key may cost you money
A key ending in %1$s is set; paste a new one to replace it

Badminton scores come from SportMicro’s Badminton Micro API on RapidAPI, with your own key: create a free RapidAPI account, subscribe to that API and paste the key here (docs/providers.md). It stays on this TV and is never sent anywhere but RapidAPI. The free plan is 100 requests a day, which the app spends at most one every 5 minutes while a badminton match is live; beyond the free tier the key may cost you money.
Badminton scores need a data key
Your badminton follows are kept, but nothing is fetched until a key is set. OK to enter one.

Scores come from ESPN’s public site feeds, which need no account, and badminton from SportMicro’s Badminton Micro API on RapidAPI with your own key, at most every 5 minutes, or, if you choose the experimental option, from BWF’s own website read through a hidden browser. None is affiliated with this app and the feeds may change or stop without notice. Nothing is fetched while no screen shows a score.
